{{Quote|It's the Noetikon of Science. My colleagues and I were chosen to represent the Jedi spirit of scientific inquiry.|Tharis Orne|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.</ref>}}
'''Tharis Orne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He was considered one of the greatest Jedi Masters of the Order during his time, and his wisdom, knowledge, and personality was later imprinted on the [[Noetikon of Science]]. This Noetikon included a complete list of every known biological, chemical and technological diseases, and Orne's personality inhabited the device along with Masters [[Vandar Tokare]] and [[Arca Jeth]].
